newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, tracking NYMEX, technicals.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, tracking NYMEX, technicals.

text.p: August Brent futures were slightly down on Thursday, tracking movements in the value of NYMEX prices, brokers said.
August Brent was last traded at $18.24, up two cents from London after moving either side of London's level in scant trading.
NYMEX August was last traded on ACCESS at $19.46 per barrel, unchanged from New York and giving up slight gains earlier.
Traders said there was news for Brent and prices were likely to trade in a technical range.
Credit Lyonnais Rouse said it saw trendline support at $18.15 and trendline resistance at $18.42, but a double top resistance at $18.39 and $18.40 gave the market a bearish pallor.
